'''Vcikas''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who was imprisoned by the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]]. When he escaped and was nearly killed by a [[Zoun mauler]] he claimed to have seen the [[Tessent]] on [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]].<ref name="Tessent" />
